entry.title: New: Bill 221 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
REPEALS ORDINANCE NO. 10-1, WHICH AMENDED THE STATE LAND USE BOUNDARIES MAP FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM THE AGRICULTURAL DISTRICT TO THE URBAN DISTRICT AT KAHULUI 2ND, NORTH KONA, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 7-5-017:042 ; and LAAC-34
